title: 28-Year-Old Learns Harsh Lesson After Robbing Apple Store For $1000
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On October 28th 2023. Officers received a 911 call in regards to a man and woman who just robbed the apple store and immediately took off when they saw police. The woman was apprehended while the man completely fled the scene in his car, leaving the woman behind. It was stated that both of them stole over $1000 of magic keyboards. This is the body-cam footage of the events that followed.
